nodes.name: Dry run on pve5
nodes.notes:
The script is deployed by calypso-deploy (ansible/minecraft.yaml) to /home/ubuntu/minecraft-reset-worlds.sh. --dry-run lists the world folders and touches nothing.

authentication must be set to privateKey -- the node defaults to password.

nodes.name: Parse dry run
nodes.notes: One item per world folder that a real reset would remove.
